concept.title: Swimming lessons for a child
concept.shortdesc: As a parent of an 8-year-old, I need to find swimming lessons or sessions nearby, so that my daughter can learn and be active.

conbody.note: Draft need (N-007). The needs catalogue is a model's draft from persona use cases and has not been agreed with stakeholders; the category links are proposals and are not confirmed.

section.title: The need
section.p: Situation: Follow-up to the football search for a second child.
A good result: Pools and clubs with lessons for her age, with times, cost and waiting lists.
How much it matters: Convenience: a miss is an inconvenience, so the bar is lower.

ul.li: What about swimming for his sister — she's 8?
learn to swim classes for kids
